name: surplace
description: SURPLACE — application de taxi-moto à Korhogo

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix Backend && npm install --prefix Application && npm install --prefix Administration
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,app,admin -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev --prefix Backend" "npm run dev --prefix Application" "npm run dev --prefix Administration"
scripts.dev:https: concurrently -n api,app,admin -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev --prefix Backend" "npm run dev:https --prefix Application" "npm run dev --prefix Administration"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix Application && npm run build --prefix Administration
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,app,admin -c blue,magenta,green "npm start --prefix Backend" "npm start --prefix Application" "npm start --prefix Administration"
